samples.analysis:
Google Chrome is open full-screen in dark mode on a **“New Incognito Tab”**. The top area contains one tab, back/forward and reload controls, a blank address/search bar with an **“AI Mode”** button, an **Incognito** indicator, and the Chrome menu. A bookmarks bar beneath it contains numerous saved links and folders.

The center of the page shows the Incognito hat-and-glasses icon and the heading **“You’ve gone Incognito”**. Explanatory text notes that Chrome won’t save browsing history, cookies and site data, or information entered in forms, while activity may still be visible to websites, an employer or school, and the internet service provider. A highlighted notice says **“Third-party cookies are blocked.”**

The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom with centered app icons; the system tray shows **6:35 PM** and **10/15/2026**.
